close_reason: connect_ws_with_limit and url_scheme both rewritten to use split_once + eq_ignore_ascii_case instead of to_ascii_lowercase. Zero-alloc scheme checks. Behaviour preserved (case-insensitive scheme matching per RFC 3986 §3.1). Also cleaned up a stray duplicate docstring from the JMAP-6lsm.23 rename.
description: src/client.rs:629-633 — `url_scheme` returns String via `url[..i].to_ascii_lowercase()`. Called from require_http_url and validate_session_urls; each call allocates. The scheme is then compared to two literals ("http", "https"). Idiomatic alternative: return Option<&str> via `split_once("://")` and compare with `eq_ignore_ascii_case`, avoiding the allocation. Equivalently, keep the function signature but return `Cow<'_, str>`. Note: locked crate.
title: url_scheme allocates a String for each scheme check
